# Simulation: Lifecycle

Lifecycle and emergent state are distributed across law functions and state modules. The solver invokes reproduction, genotype/phenotype, radiation, stellar, exotic, relativity, quantum, synthetic, group, economy, governance, and infrastructure passes according to their law gates and cadence contracts.
